messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑condition) | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | In | locative preposition “in” (introduces the domain “all parts”) | **ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ** | “in the parts” | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” | **ಎಲ್ಲಾ** | “all” | OK | | parti | set of “parts” (spatial divisions) | **ಭಾಗಗಳು** | “parts” | OK | | impera | verb “governs” (exerts rule over each part) | **ಆಡಳಿತ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ** | “governs” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **ಮತ್ತು** | “and” | OK | | quivi | locative adverb “there” (pointing to the place of reign) | **ಅಲ್ಲಿ** | “there” | OK | | regge | verb “reigns” (holds sovereign authority) | **ಆಡಳಿತ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ** | “reigns” | OK | | quivi | locative adverb “there” (point of existence) | **ಅಲ್ಲಿ** | “there” | OK | | è | copular verb “is/exists” | **ಇದೆ** | “is/exists” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine singular) – not lexical in Kannada | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective “His” (ownership) | **ಅವನ** | “His” | OK | | città | noun “city” (urban domain) | **ನಗರ** | “city” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **ಮತ್ತು** | “and” | OK | | l'alto | adjective “lofty” (qualifies the seat) – article omitted in Kannada | **ಉನ್ನತ** | “lofty” | **UNNECESSARY** (article part) | | seggio | noun “seat” (throne) | **ಆಸನ** | “seat” | OK | | oh | interjection “O” (vocative) | **ಓ** | “O” | OK | | felice | adjective “happy” (describes the chosen one) | **ಸಂತೋಷವಂತನು** | “happy one” | OK | | colui | pronoun “he” (the one who is elected) | **ಅವನು** | “he” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “whom” (introduces relative clause) | **ಅವನನ್ನು** | “whom” | OK | | ivi | locative adverb “there/thereto” (place of election) | **ಅಲ್ಲಿ** | “there” | OK | | elegge | verb “elects” (selects) | **ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ** | “elects” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la` (definite article) – Kannada does not use articles, so it is omitted. - **UNNECESSARY**: `l'alto` – the article component (`l'`) is omitted; only the adjective “ಉನ್ನತ” is retained.
All other source tokens are accounted for with correct lexical equivalents and appropriate grammatical agreement.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 127: - Original: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಆಡಳಿತ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡಳಿತ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 128: - Original: ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಉನ್ನತ ಆಸನ ಇದೆ: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 129: - Original: ಓ ಸಂತೋಷವಂತನು, ಅವನನ್ನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ!». - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
```kannada ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಆಡಳಿತ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡಳಿತ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಉನ್ನತ ಆಸನ ಇದೆ: ಓ ಸಂತೋಷವಂತನು, ಅವನನ್ನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ!». ```
